design_brief.description: Parametric seven-segment LED display module model with a rectangular body, front digit aperture/segments sized to given digit envelope and segment width, and a 5x2 through-hole pin grid on the rear/bottom face.

metadata.description: Parametric seven-segment LED display module: rectangular body with front recess and seven-segment apertures, plus 5x2 through-hole pin grid and protruding pin leads. All dimensions derived from primary_dimension.

primary_dimension.description: Primary anchor dimension; all other dimensions are proportional to this.

digit_width.description: Digit envelope width (X) on the front face.

digit_height.description: Digit envelope height (Y) on the front face.

segment_gap.description: Gap between segments and digit envelope edges.

segment_depth.description: Depth of segment apertures into the body from the front.

front_bezel_radius.description: Bezel corner radius (approximated via cylinders + hull).

front_recess_depth.description: Depth of the front aperture recess.

pin_length.description: Pin lead protrusion length below the body.

pin_standoff_from_body.description: Extra gap between body bottom and pin start (kept 0 for connectivity).

pin_array_centered.description: Boolean-like (0/1). When 1, pin grid is centered on body.

overlap.description: Small overlap used to guarantee solid connectivity.

sketch.prompt:
Draw a clean, minimalistic orthographic technical line sketch of the described object on a white background. Use thin black lines only — no shading, no color, no photorealism, no perspective distortion. Keep proportions realistic. Show the front or three-quarter view that most clearly reveals all canonical parts of the object. If helpful, label key dimensions in millimeters with small arrows, but keep labels sparse. The sketch should look like a designer's concept drawing, suitable as a reference for a parametric CAD model.

OBJECT: A seven-segment LED display module: 12.7 mm x 19 mm body, 8.2 mm thick, 7.2 mm wide x 12.7 mm tall digits, 1.2 mm segment width, 5 x 2 pin grid.
REQUIRED PARTS (must be visible in the sketch): main_body, digit_face, seven_segment_geometry, pin_array, display, led, mod, pin
PROPORTIONAL CONSTRAINTS — primary_dimension = 13mm (category: generic).
All other parts of the sketch must scale consistently with this total size — no exaggerated wheels, handles, or details.
APPROX DIMENSIONS: body_width≈12.7mm, body_height≈19.0mm, body_thickness≈8.2mm, digit_width≈7.2mm, digit_height≈12.7mm, segment_width≈1.2mm
NOTE: Pin pitch is not specified in the request; defaults to 2.54 mm (0.1 in). If a different pitch or exact pin placement relative to body edges is required, provide those dimensions.

Keep the final image below 1024x1024, clean white background, no text outside the dimension labels, no watermark.
